court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: 3rd Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Satara, Marriage Petition No.433 of 2017
case_name: Satish Alias Dhanaji Mahadeo Ghadge v. Sarika Satish Alias Dhanaji Ghadge
facts_of_case: The husband seeks dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(1b) of the Hindu Marriage Act. The wife had left the matrimonial house and refused to reside with him. She pleaded that she was subjected to physical and mental harassment, suspecting her character.

legal_principles.principle: When the relationship between the husband and wife is not severed and they were residing together, a presumption in favour of the legitimacy of the child can be drawn.
legal_principles.held: Making a reference of Section 112 of the Indian Evidence Act and drawing a presumption in favour of the legitimacy of the child, observing that when the relationship between the husband and the wife is not severed and they were residing together and they continued in a valid marriage, learned Judge has rejected the application.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to disprove the legitimacy of a child to show that the relationship between the husband and wife was severed.
